newsitem.title: USA: General Dynamics says outlook bright.
newsitem.headline: General Dynamics says outlook bright.

text.p: General Dynamics said Wednesday it is in excellent financial condition, and the outlook for all of its major businesses is "bright."
The company said it has virtually no debt, and even after its recent acquisitions, it still has almost $700 million in cash.
The company said funded backlog for continuing operations at the end of the 1997 first quarter was $6.7 billion, while total backlog (funded and unfunded) for continuing operations was $10.6 billion.
The company said comparable backlogs for the first quarter of 1996 were $4.8 billion and $7 billion, respectively.
Sales for General Dynamics' Combat Systems segment were up by 37 percent, and operating earnings increased by 36 percent over the same period last year, the company said.

General Dynamics said earnings in its marine business segment were up by nine percent even though sales for the quarter were down nine percent, as volumes declined in the submarine unit. Increased margins in the submarine business resulted principally from "excellent performance in cost management," the company said.
